title: Period of the feast of S. Lawrence
html_source:
https://www.catholicculture.org/culture/liturgicalyear/calendar/day.cfm?date=2019-08-10

Lawrence was one of the seven deacons in Rome 258 AD who were martyred during the Christian persecution. He was tortured to death by being roasted over a gridiron, to which he was quoted saying, “I’m well done on this side, turn me over!”
